new_tests.execution: included in the final targeted and full runs; not a separate final 25-test invocation

targeted_tests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests/threshold_candidates -v

full_regression.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

development_fixture_correction.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests/threshold_candidates/gf/i3_hash_join_v0_1 -t tests -v
development_fixture_correction.failure: Manual test transcript initially used u32 lengths; canonical H_RBBC transcript uses u64 lengths.
development_fixture_correction.resolution: Corrected manual fixture to u64; added two boundary tests; all final 25 tests pass in both final runs.

semantics.input_extension: extra PRIVATE unverified CAP commitment candidate; frozen formal X/W unchanged
semantics.CAP_parser: existing strict legacy18 parse_commitment, with exact bytes/length and re-encoding check; no extraction
semantics.CAP_salt_binding: same two canonical rho salts; necessary equality only
semantics.digest_consumer: actual H_RBBC over full-M d_M and exact candidate, including canonical 64-bit transcript field lengths
semantics.I2_recomputation: twice from the same immutable M; not native same-wire evidence
semantics.I3_beta_match: matched_unverified_cap; arbitrary r/beta repair and changed rho roots can still match
semantics.CAP_rho_and_derived_mask: both OPEN; no general legacy18 CAP execution provider enabled
semantics.failure_order: candidate grammar precedes partial crypto; partial binding/errors and salt mismatches skip H_RBBC
semantics.ordinary_I4_I5_mismatch: permits independent candidate hash diagnostic; computation ERROR skips it
semantics.diagnostic_payload: only safe predecessor diagnostic and fixed check/status labels

test_limitations: Synthetic canonical CAP commitment, real GF reference I4/I5 and canonical rho; no complete I3 honest positive fixture.
Real H_RBBC positive and M-header/C/candidate mutation cases execute Anemoi. Pure flow/mask/root tests reuse a real baseline image only after asserting identical hash arguments.
Manual transcript construction shares the existing Anemoi primitive; not an independent Anemoi implementation or upstream KAT.
No concurrency, crash recovery, one-time state, CAP extraction, native replay, proving or opening is exercised by this new module.
preserved_scope: frozen GF wire ABI and domains
